title: Enlightenment from Lv Shuxiang’s Thoughtss on the Cultural and Creative Design of Silver Ornaments of the She Ethnic Group in Eastern Fujian
content: This paper explores the core concepts of Lv Shuxiang's views on cultural inheritance and innovation. It examines the application of his ideas to the preservation and innovation of She silver jewelry culture. In this study, the unique role of She silver ornaments in cultural inheritance is thoroughly discussed. This paper explains how his ideas guide the creative design of She silver ornaments to harmoniously blend tradition and modernity, demonstrating their practical application. The results indicate that his ideas are significant for both the innovation of She silver jewelry and the broader inheritance and innovation of Chinese culture, forming an important part of China's cultural heritage and innovation efforts.
